text:
maya: Quick alert 56mdash; canary rollout for telemetry-service halted during prefetch. Deploybot reported manifest vs cache checksum mismatch and paused promo.

deploy-bot: [status] prefetch error service=telemetry shard=1 reason=manifest-checksum-drift artifact=telemetry:sha256:1a2b...3c4d. No compatible blob found in prefetch cache.

josh: Hm, saw similar earlier today on a different service. Usually caused by a race where the publisher rewrites manifest after uploading blobs.

sean: Any quick mitigation? Can we promote with ignore-checksum or should we fallback to last-known-good?

maya: Not comfortable ignoring checksum. If manifest points to non-existent layer we'll break canary.

josh: Quick options: 1) targeted cache invalidation + re-prefetch (fast), 2) pin to previous digest and promote, 3) abort and rollback current canary.

sean: I'm leaning to pin+promote if cache flush fails. If we pin, we should also mark the release notes and add a follow-up to harden registry writes.

maya: @josh please try a targeted cache invalidate for telemetry shard=1 then run prefetch. If that succeeds, promote. If it fails twice, we pin to sha256:9f8e...7a6b and promote.

josh: Running: ```deploybot cache flush --service=telemetry --shard=1 && deploybot prefetch --service=telemetry --shard=1 --run-id=rb-20260321-24```

ci-bot: [echo] run rb-20260321-24 queued on runner-11.

josh: Prefetch finished 56mdash; still failing: "ERROR Prefetch: manifest checksum mismatch (expected 0x1e2f != actual 0x7c9b) reading s3://internal-artifacts/telemetry/20260321/manifest.json"

maya: Ok, cache flush didn't help. Sean, you ok with pin+promote plan?

sean: Yes. Please pin and promote only to canary. Also disable auto-rollout to prod until we confirm re-promotion succeeds.

josh: Pinning to last-good image: `telemetry:sha256:9f8e...7a6b`. Command: ```deploybot promote --service=telemetry --image=sha256:9f8e7a6b --to=canary --reason="prefetch checksum drift" --no-auto-rollout```

deploy-bot: [action] Promotion started by josh -> target=canary image=sha256:9f8e7a6b id=prom-20260321-14 healthchecks=enabled.

ci-bot: [monitor] Healthcheck logs: readiness probes passed. Traffic shift to canary at 5% completed.

maya: Great. Sean, can you add a short release note blurb and mark change-window as "canary pinned / prod deferred"? I'll open a GH issue to investigate registry idempotency (writer retries, manifest atomic replace).

sean: Note added and GH issue created: "registry-manifest-race: add write-then-verify and read-after-write retry for 60s; track metrics for manifest rewrite frequency." Link: https://github.com/redwood/release/issues/482

josh: Also filing a tiny prefetcher change to retry manifest reads for 30s when checksum mismatch occurs before failing. I'll attach to the GH issue.

maya: OK. We'll keep canary pinned for now and resume full rollout once registry consistency is validated. Marking this thread resolved unless further regressions.

deploy-bot: [log] prom-20260321-14 complete canary digest=sha256:9f8e7a6b rollback-safe=true.

ci-bot: [note] Incident window: telemetry-canary prefetch stall resolved (duration ~4m)."
